question: Should approval prompts be bound to the proposal version they describe, causing an old approve, reject, or quarantine action to fail closed after the proposal is revised?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but this deliberately changes a user-visible approval contract and requires maintainer intent rather than an automated code judgment.

options.title: Accept snapshot binding
options.body: Keep the proposed fail-closed approval behavior while retaining ID-only compatibility for direct service, CLI, and tool calls.

options.title: Ship preview only
options.body: Land canonical previews and pagination but defer lifecycle version binding to a narrower compatibility discussion.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the existing summary-only approval flow and pause the paired feature request.

recommendation.title: Accept snapshot binding
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed fail-closed approval behavior while retaining ID-only compatibility for direct service, CLI, and tool calls.
